Hi, I am Aditya, from India. I am studying Mechanical Engineering, in the final year of my Bachelor's Degree. I am working on thermal plasmas with Dr. Patricio Mendez via the MITACS program.
I play badminton and enjoy playing the piano. I dream of working in the aerospace industry someday.

## Project

Physics of Thermal Plasmas at Atmospheric Pressure
